  • Deposit your money here!
  • Deposit your money here in the safety of the Tibian Bank!
  • Any questions about the functions of your bank account? Feel free to ask me for help!

Location

Newhaven Bank

Notes

This NPC has no notes.

Transcripts

To change these transcripts, edit the transcripts page for Flavius.

Player: hi
Flavius: Welcome to the Tibian bank, young adventurer! Deposit your gold or withdraw your money from your bank account. Remember to deposit all of your gold before you leave here. I can also explain the functions of your bank account to you.
Player: bye
Flavius: Goodbye.
Player: name
Flavius: My name is Flavius, how may I assist you today?
Player: job
Flavius: I`m the banker here in Newhaven. It's my job to manage your bank account and change currencies. Though I may also help with questions you might have.
Player: mission / quest
Flavius: I'm just a banker, ask around maybe someone else could need your help.
Player: Flavius
Flavius: Mhm?
Player: Anna
Flavius: She often travels to the mainland for supplies. I bet she can help you once you've reached level 8. You can find her at the ferry house just west of here.
Player: Avriel
Flavius: Avriel runs a small shop here in the village. You can buy useful things for your adventures, but also sell things you might not need any longer. You will find his shop in the south of the village.
Player: Gustavo
Flavius: Ah, my good friend Gustavo, he's keeping us safe from the north part of this island. It can get pretty dangerous out there.
Player: Viola
Flavius: She's a well-read woman who knows a thing or two about magic. Maybe she can teach you a few spells. She might also have a small task for you. I've heard she's missing one of her books.
Player: Tim
Flavius: Isn't that the guard from Thais? I heard Gustavo talking about their ongoing friendship despite being apart.
Player: Thais
Flavius: Thais is our beautiful capital, ruled by our beloved king Tibianus III.
Player: Newhaven
Flavius: I heard the name refers to older times, where the economy was thriving much more than it does today.
Player: island
Flavius: If you enjoy the life outside of busy cities, you've come to the right place.
Player: king / Tibianus
Flavius: Our dearest King Tibianus, maybe someday I will be able to meet his highness. He resides at his castle in Thais.
Player: mines
Flavius: Ever since the mining industry left our beautiful village, the mines have been haunted. I'd rather stay away from any kind of danger. But I heard Viola could need your help, adventurer.
Flavius: Though if you're really interested, I have the feeling these news could spark interest again ...
Player: news
Flavius: What news?!
Flavius: Oh I remember, that rockslide, right?
Flavius: At night time, just a few days ago ... There was a loud bang. Turns out that a weird explosion revealed a yet unknown part of the mines.
Flavius: But I'll tell you nothing will get me to visit it first!
Player: helmet
Flavius: It's actually true?!
Flavius: I can't believe it ...
Flavius: I'm sorry but I don't know what to do now, maybe keep it or trade it for something even more precious.
Flavius: No matter how you decide, I'd keep it safe!
Player: time
Flavius: It is exactly <time>.

Flavius
